name: guhbot-discord
description: GuhBot, a Discord bot with slash commands, built with discord.ts (discordx).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.build:tests: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('.test-build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('package.json', '.test-build/package.json')"
